sourceDecision: Retain production. The standalone public KvBrowser main declares min-w-0 space-y-6 p-3 sm:p-6. Both Mounts and Paths sections use the imported surface constant, declared min-w-0 space-y-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 p-4. Their conditional MetadataTable call sites sit in fragments inside those sections; the shared table declares an overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 div around its w-full text-sm table. These are literal source declarations, not computed container sizing, flex/grid shrink behavior, viewport containment, scrolling, clipping, wrapping, zoom or accessibility evidence. Saved public metadata harnesses substitute surface with the literal string surface and replace the real table; they cannot qualify the actual containment composition. No concrete supported correction compatible with all frozen expectations was established.
